test_cases.name: ford_official_variants
assertions: Returns one or two optimized JPG files
At least one is the official Ford oval or script logo
Images are square 1024x1024 with white background

test_cases.name: apple_single_or_double
assertions: Returns optimized JPG of official Apple logo
Image is centered with padding suitable for circular crop

test_cases.name: starbucks_wordmark_preference

Single option is official logo only
Uses official sources rather than generated approximations
